title: Setting Austin's Future Goals
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin City Council convened a special meeting focused entirely on high-level strategic planning.
*   The sole item on the agenda was to discuss and deliberate the city's policy priorities and goals.
*   This strategic session aimed to establish guiding principles for the council's future actions and decision-making.
transcript:
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING 
 
Monday, June 13, 2016 
The Austin City Council will convene at 12:00 PM on 
Monday, June 13, 2016 at the Palmer Events Center 
900 Barton Springs Rd, Austin, TX 78704 
 
 
 
Mayor Steve Adler

1. Discuss policy priorities and goals for the Austin City Council.
